mail.auto: Yeh {{app_name}} ki taraf se bheja gaya automatic message hai — kripya is email ka jawab na dein.

b: Namaste {{user_name}}, humein aapka password reset karne ki request mili hai.
[Naya password chunne ke liye yahan click karein]({{reset_link}}) — yeh link {{expires_in}} me expire ho jayega.
Agar aapne yeh request nahi ki thi to is email ko ignore kar dein.
Namaste {{user_name}}, aapka password {{changed_at}} ko badla gaya.
Agar yeh aapne nahi kiya to turant {{support_email}} se sampark karein.
Namaste {{user_name}}, humne {{signed_in_at}} ko {{location}} me {{device}} se naya sign-in dekha.
Agar yeh aap the to kuch karne ki zaroorat nahi. Agar nahi, to turant apna password badal lein.

invited.s: {{app_name}} par {{company}} me aapko invite kiya gaya hai
b: {{invited_by}} ne aapko {{app_name}} par {{company}} se {{role}} ke roop me judne ke liye invite kiya hai.
Shuru karne ke liye [invitation accept karein]({{accept_link}}).

userAdded.h: Ek naya user add kiya gaya
b: {{added_by}} ne {{new_user_name}} ({{new_user_email}}) ko {{role}} ke roop me add kiya.
[Users aur roles dekhein]({{users_url}})
Namaste {{user_name}}, {{changed_by}} ne aapka role {{old_role}} se badalkar {{new_role}} kar diya hai.

accountConnected.h: Ek social account connect ho gaya
b: {{connected_by}} ne {{connected_at}} ko {{account_name}} ({{provider}}) connect kiya.
[Social accounts dekhein]({{accounts_url}})
{{app_name}} is par post karta rahe, iske liye {{account_name}} ({{provider}}) ko dobara connect karna hoga.
[Abhi dobara connect karein]({{accounts_url}})
"{{post_excerpt}}" ko {{published_at}} ko {{platforms}} par publish kiya gaya.

postFailed.s: Ek post publish nahi ho saki
postFailed.h: Ek post publish nahi ho saki
b: "{{post_excerpt}}" ko {{platforms}} par publish nahi kiya ja saka: {{error_reason}}.
[Dekhein aur dobara try karein]({{posts_url}})

approvalRequested.s: {{submitted_by}} ne approval ke liye ek post bheji
approvalRequested.h: Ek post ko aapka review chahiye
b: {{submitted_by}} ne "{{post_excerpt}}" ko approval ke liye bheja hai.
[Abhi review karein]({{approvals_url}})

approvalDecided.h: Aapki post par faisla ho gaya
b: {{reviewer}} ne "{{post_excerpt}}" par faisla diya: {{decision}}.
{{reason}}

newComment.h: Aapko ek naya comment mila hai
b: {{commenter_name}} ne "{{post_excerpt}}" par comment kiya: “{{comment_text}}”
[Inbox me jawab dein]({{inbox_url}})
